transcript: So this is the famous Coyote Cafe. But if you're pregnant and you're like in your nine and a half months and you still haven't had your baby, you come here and you have the baby salad. The Coyote Cafe famous baby salad. And women literally go into labor after they've eaten the salad or sometimes during the moment that they're eating the salad. So there's actually a picture in here. All of the people that have babies from after they eat the salad write their names on the wall.
